name: Mazzin (Italy)
description: Vertical stripes of purple, yellow, blue, white, green, brown, blue and purple with a red hoist edge, the central white stripe charged with the crowned municipal arms of Mazzin (flowers on a mill wheel) within branches and the name MAZIN.
history: Municipal flag of Mazzin, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: multicoloured vertical stripes, white at the centre
Mazzin arms — flowers on a mill wheel, crowned, within branches, with the name MAZIN and motto scroll
